title.narrative: AU, African Risk Capacity, AgencyBridge Financing
African Risk Capacity, Agency Bridge Financing

description.narrative: Insatsen syftar till att slutföra etablering av African Risk Capaciy (ARC), inklusive instutionalisera Agencys och dess sekretariats funktioner; bilda och kapitalisera försäkringsbolaget ARC Ltd,; hantera kapacitetsuppbyggnadsprogrammet i varje kandidatland i syfte att förbättra riskhanteringssystem, inklusive anpassa Afrika RiskView (ARV) väderprogramvaran, välja risköverföringsparametrar, och utveckla beredskapsplaner och säkerställa deras kvalitet.

This intervention aims (valued at 49 million SEK) to complete the establishmnent of ARC, including instutionalising the functions of the Agency and its Secretariat, establishing and capitalising ARC Ltd, the insurance company, and managing the national-level multi-stakeholder capacity building programme in each candidate country with the aim of improving risk management systems, including customising Africa RiskView weather risk quantification software, selecting risk transfer parameters, and developing drought-response contingency plans lined to an ARC payout.

In November 2012, the African Risk Capacity (ARC) was established by treaty as a Specialised Agency of the African Union (AU). Sweden has supported the Agency since the onset, providing unearmarked funding with the latest contribution closing in June 2017. The ARC has come a far way since its establishment. It has developed or is in the process of completing the development of additional insurance products to cover hazards beyond drought, including tropical cyclones, flooding and outbreaks and epidemics. Although it has been hampered by a number of challenges, especially in terms of increasing its risk pool at the pace planned (its core business) it has stayed on track in the other areas of its work. There has also been a significant development in the level of understanding and incountry capacities on understanding the concepts of risk transfer, risk management and sovereign weather Insurance. Experience in implementing the ARC mechanism has demonstrated the need to link the technical and political bridge regarding insurance and the role it plays in supporting resilience.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
